title: She Was Hiding This In Her Bra…
description:
On February 16th, 2022, an officer on patrol noticed a vehicle driving recklessly and at a very high speed. He quickly turned on his emergency lights, but the suspect vehicle did not stop. After a long chase, the officers were able to corner the car. The officers checked the car for any intoxicants that the suspects might have been hiding. The police found $6,480 in cash, prescription dr*gs, and a bag full of marijuana in the car. The man was unwilling to give any information to the officer, making the investigation difficult. Both of them were taken to jail for further questioning and investigation. The man was charged with narcotics violations, narcotics equipment violations, and driving with a suspended license with knowledge, while the woman was charged with criminal traffic offenses and possession of marijuana.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
